name: create_client
description: Create a new tax-planning client in the active workspace.

name: upload_return_document
description: Attach/ingest a Form 1040 source document to a client tax year for OCR extraction.

name: get_extracted_return
description: Retrieve the extracted (OCR/parsed) return and its fields for review.

name: correct_extracted_field
description: Correct a single extracted field value before confirming the return.

name: confirm_return
description: Confirm an extracted return, promoting it to the engine truth substrate.

name: create_tax_plan
description: Create a tax plan (scenario container) for a client tax year.

name: update_scenario_assumptions
description: Update the scenario assumptions on a plan, triggering recomputation by the engine.

name: list_strategy_library
description: List the catalog of available tax strategies.

name: add_client_strategy
description: Add a strategy from the library to a client's plan.

name: compute_quarterly
description: Compute estimated quarterly tax payments for a plan via the engine.

name: generate_plan_pdf
description: Generate a PDF document for the plan.
params: path: id (plan_tax_year_id); body: optional render options

name: upsert_strategy_library
description: Admin: create or update an entry in the strategy library catalog.

name: upsert_tax_bracket_set
description: Admin: create or update a tax bracket set (constants) used by the engine.

name: scan_book
description: Agent: scan the book of clients for planning opportunities/flags.

name: run_strategist
description: Run the AI tax-strategist over a client tax year to produce situation-aware findings and a draft memo.
params: path: tax_year_id; body: optional run options

name: get_memo
description: Get the current advisory memo state for a client tax year.

name: save_memo
description: Save/replace the advisory memo body (markdown) for a client tax year.

name: sign_memo
description: Sign and seal a memo, locking it as a finalized advisory document.

name: list_pending_memos
description: List memos pending review/signature across the workspace.

name: recompute_scenario
description: Agent: recompute a what-if scenario for a tax year by setting and/or delta-adjusting engine input fields.

name: emr_sweep
description: Agent: sweep the effective marginal rate (EMR) across income to find brackets/cliffs for a tax year.
params: path: tax_year_id; body: optional sweep options

name: optimize_roth
description: Agent: optimize a Roth conversion amount for a tax year against bracket/EMR constraints.

name: optimize_scorp
description: Agent: optimize reasonable-compensation / S-corp salary split for a tax year.

name: list_tasks
description: List implementation tasks for a client tax year's plan.

name: create_task
description: Create an implementation task on a client tax year's plan.
params: path: client_tax_year_id; body: task fields (title, owner, due_date, ...)

name: update_task
description: Update an implementation task (status, owner, due date, etc.).
params: path: task_id; body: fields to update

name: list_statutory_deadlines
description: List statutory filing/payment deadlines, optionally for a given tax year.

name: list_realized
description: List realized (actual) outcomes reconciled against a plan.

name: reconcile_realized
description: Reconcile a realized outcome against the plan for a client tax year.
params: path: client_tax_year_id; body: realized outcome fields

name: realized_rollup
description: Agent: roll up realized outcomes vs plan across the book.

name: read_journal
description: Read the lifecycle audit journal (append-only event log).
